ns2:section.sectionText: Western Civ to 1660, 3 hours. In this course we will examine the political, social, and cultural history of western civilization from antiquity to about 1660. In each class we will examine and discuss primary sources. Requirements also include exams, essays, and weekly writing assignments. This course satisfies the General Education Criteria for the Humanities & the Arts course. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. http://www.history.uiuc.edu/fac_dir/koslofsky_dir/koslofsky.html
